config.parameterization: block points scaled by w/shipCap, total renormalized to 110; sentiment raw = 0 in backtest (no historical feed)

adoptionCriteria.rule: CLUSTER-robust: combos whose exact-tie cluster (differing only in blocks with identically-zero raw contribution — sentiment here) has positive mean Spearman in BOTH halves under the engine-exact rounded scorer for EVERY variant, plus the same criteria under the unrounded scorer; overall Spearman >= baseline + 0.10 and top-quintile-minus-middle > 0. Rationale: variants that differ only in a zero-contribution block are the same ranking up to rounding tie-breaks — if the OOS sign depends on which variant you pick, it is not robust.
